A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fascial system is a reliable source of vascular supply for skin flaps.
the vascular system of the leg is a highly organised and reliable system which provides a basis for the planning of skin flaps.
the skin of the leg is supplied by perforators from the fascial septa.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a thorough knowledge of anatomy is essential for the planning of fasciocutaneous flaps.
the vascular system of the fascia can be exploited to provide skin coverage in below-knee surgery.
the vascular supply of flaps is based on the vascular supply to the fascial layers and that the fascia should be preserved whenever possible.
